evidence_usage_boundary.current: artifacts with freshness=current in artifact_index.json; produced by validated tool runs in the current or recent rounds
evidence_usage_boundary.stale: artifacts with freshness=stale; can be referenced as historical context but NOT as current evidence for decision-making
evidence_usage_boundary.missing: artifacts with freshness=missing; cannot be used as evidence; must be regenerated or marked as not needed
evidence_usage_boundary.unknown: capabilities or artifacts not yet inventoried; must be assessed before use

evidence_mappings.gap_description: IDA / IDAPython tool output can be registered in artifact_index but lacks full StructuredEvidence mapping
evidence_mappings.details: tool_runners.py parses IDA JSON output into ToolRunArtifact with structured_evidence list; evidence.py provides StructuredEvidence dataclass and factory functions; local_reverse_single_sample_static_triage.py consumes IDA JSON for triage

evidence_mappings.gap_description: Ghidra has no tool integration; no output to register or map
evidence_mappings.details: no Ghidra headless analyzer, script runner, or evidence adapter exists in the codebase

evidence_mappings.gap_description: OllyDbg / x64dbg / debugger tool output can be registered in artifact_index but lacks full StructuredEvidence mapping
evidence_mappings.details: tool_runners.py parses OllyDbg JSON output into ToolRunArtifact with structured_evidence; olly_scripts/ contains 28 audit/probe scripts; ollydbg_preflight.py provides non-invasive configuration check

evidence_mappings.gap_description: strings / file / objdump / radare2 tool output can be registered in artifact_index but lacks full StructuredEvidence mapping
evidence_mappings.details: static_feature_extractor.py provides pure Python string extraction (no external tool dependency); no StructuredEvidence factory for generic string extraction results; no file/objdump/radare2 integration

evidence_mappings.gap_description: solver templates tool output can be registered in artifact_index but lacks full StructuredEvidence mapping
evidence_mappings.details: sample_solver.py provides generic solver framework; local_reverse_solver_profiles.py provides profile dispatch; corpus_static_audit.py generates gap reports

evidence_mappings.gap_description: symbolic / constraint solver (Z3 / angr) tool output can be registered in artifact_index but lacks full StructuredEvidence mapping
evidence_mappings.details: samplereverse_z3.py uses z3 with graceful import fallback; advanced_solvers.py uses angr with graceful import fallback; local_reverse_constraint_recovery.py dispatches constraint recovery; no StructuredEvidence factory for Z3/angr results

evidence_mappings.gap_description: harness tool output can be registered in artifact_index but lacks full StructuredEvidence mapping
evidence_mappings.details: harness.py orchestrates compare-aware campaigns; produces case results and artifact manifests; artifact_index.json registers harness outputs

evidence_mappings.gap_description: sample metadata tool output can be registered in artifact_index but lacks full StructuredEvidence mapping
evidence_mappings.details: local_reverse_inventory.py builds inventory from LOCAL_REVERSE_ROOT; local_samples.py manages sample metadata; corpus_loader.py loads corpus cases; no StructuredEvidence factory for metadata
project_state.py builds and manages artifact_index.json; project_gate.py reads artifact_index for gate checks; tracks freshness (current/stale/missing), SHA256, size_bytes, source_run

evidence.py defines StructuredEvidence dataclass and factory functions for Base64/RC4/UTF16LE material evidence; tool_runners.py parses tool output into StructuredEvidence; strategies and pipeline consume StructuredEvidence

minimum_requirements: IDA executable configured and reachable (tool_runners.py IDA runner)
IDA script path set (ida_scripts/collect_evidence.py or equivalent)
LOCAL_REVERSE_ROOT environment variable pointing to sample directory
adapter_schema_fields_needed: tool_capability_inventory.json: capability entry for IDA with current_status=implemented
structured_evidence_gap_report.json: evidence mapping for IDA output
artifact_index.json: freshness tracking for static triage artifacts
current_blockers: IDA must be installed and configured on the system
IDA script must produce valid JSON evidence
local_reverse_training_next_queue.json must have inventory_only samples with allowed_next_action containing bounded_static_triage
